function.name: NEW_MAP
function.param: Width in pixels of the new graph
Height in pixels of the new graph
Depth of colour (in bits per pixel: 1, 8 or 16)
function.abstract: It creates a new graph on memory

description.p: This function creates a new graph with the size and number of bits per pixel of colour determined. The graph is created inside of the library 0, and it is assigned any avaliable number, which has not been used for other graph.

The depth of colour has the next meaning:
A graph of 1 bit per pixel has not information of colour. The pixels to 0 represent transparent pixels, and the bits to 1 will be drawn using the colour chosen by the function .
A graph of 8 bits per pixel has 256 avaliable values for each pixel. Each value represents an index in a general table of colours, the palette of colours, which affects to all graphs of 8 bits.
A grpah of 16 bits holds information of the components: red, green and blue of each pixel, so that is independent of any palette of colours. The exact codification of that components inside of the 16 bits depends of the video card, so that only it is valid to create and to use graphs of 16 bits if before it has been set a graph mode of 16 bits.
The new graph is created with all pixels to 0 (they are transparents).
